title: Consumer Protection Act, 2002
verified_how: Fetched e-Laws API act-versions and doc-search for statute/02c30: title 'Consumer Protection Act, 2002, S.O. 2002, c. 30, Sched. A', state 'current', consolidated from 2025-12-11; ynote says it contains some not-yet-in-force provisions.
notes: This is the Act in force now. Its enacted replacement, the Consumer Protection Act, 2023 (S.O. 2023, c. 23, Sched. 1, https://www.ontario.ca/laws/statute/23c23), is on e-Laws with the note 'THIS ACT IS NOT YET IN FORCE. It comes into force on a day to be named by proclamation', so it is not listed separately.
